# TLS Certificates for Unseal Vault

## Files Generated by `generate-tls.sh`

| File | Purpose | Git? |
|------|---------|------|
| `ca.crt` | CA certificate — shared with Main Vault to verify TLS | ❌ No |
| `vault.crt` | Unseal Vault server certificate | ❌ No |
| `vault.key` | Unseal Vault server private key | ❌ No |

## Steps

```bash
# 1. Generate certs
UNSEAL_VAULT_DNS=unseal-vault.vault-unseal.svc.cluster.local \
UNSEAL_VAULT_IP=<pod-ip-if-needed> \
bash generate-tls.sh

# 2. Create K8s secrets (on server)
kubectl create secret generic unseal-vault-tls \
  --from-file=ca.crt=certs/ca.crt \
  --from-file=vault.crt=certs/vault.crt \
  --from-file=vault.key=certs/vault.key \
  --namespace=vault-unseal

# 3. Share CA with gamebox-security namespace (Main Vault needs it)
kubectl create secret generic unseal-vault-ca \
  --from-file=ca.crt=certs/ca.crt \
  --namespace=gamebox-security
```

## ⚠️ Security

- Never commit private keys or CA keys to Git
- Store CA private key offline (it was auto-deleted by the script)
- Renew server cert every 2 years (`CERT_DAYS=730`)
